topic.title: Working as a Content Author
topic.shortdesc: Authors use to manage projects, edit content, run reviews, publish deliverables, and work with AI-assisted features.

body.p: This section explains the typical workflow for content Authors who create, manage, review, and publish content in .

Authors have access to project-based functionality. They can work with repositories, edit content in a personal workspace, create review tasks, integrate feedback, configure publications and deliverables, and manage project settings.
The Author platform user role (license) is designed specifically for this type of user.
When working with projects, users with the Author platform user role (license) can have the Collaborator project role (private projects only), Maintainer project role, or Owner project role.

section.title: What Authors Can Do (Depending on Project Role)

ul.li: Create and manage projects (project Maintainers and Owners).
Edit content in a personal workspace.
Configure publications and deliverables (project Maintainers and Owners).
Manage project settings and members (project Owners only).
Start with Projects overview. Then continue with Personal workspace and Project review tasks.
For publishing workflows, see Publications and Deliverables.
For advanced authoring support, see AI functionality and Project settings and members.
When you are ready to start working with projects hands on, see the Projects section for instructions on how to use the application.
For details about working with review tasks, see the Review Tasks section.
